one_liner: Team messaging and collaboration platform with channels, DMs, and an extensive app/integration platform.

auth.evidence_quote: OAuth allows a user in any Slack workspace to install your app.
auth.notes: Bot tokens issued via OAuth install are long-lived bearer tokens (xoxb-...).

access.evidence_quote: Occurs if attempting to install a published app for which the requested scopes aren't approved either because they're still in review for that app, or they weren't yet submitted for review by the app developer.
access.notes: Free Slack workspace signup is self-serve; a published/public-distribution app must go through Slack app review before it can request scopes for other workspaces broadly.

api.evidence_quote: Those scopes determine exactly which doors your app can open.
api.notes: Slack's Web API has hundreds of methods (broad). An official Slack MCP server existed in the modelcontextprotocol/servers repo but search results indicate it was archived; multiple actively maintained community MCP servers exist (e.g. korotovsky/slack-mcp-server).

verdict.rationale: Free workspace + OAuth2 gives a working credential immediately, but acting on arbitrary third-party workspaces at scale requires Slack app review.
